把「力改变运动」变成算术：知道力，就能预言物体下一秒在哪里。: Turned “force changes motion” into arithmetic: know the force, predict the motion.
第一次用同一条公式算清苹果落地和月球绕地，天上的运动从此可以预报。: One formula for a falling apple and the Moon — the heavens became predictable.
质量是凝固的能量：解释了太阳凭什么烧几十亿年，也打开了核能时代。: Mass is frozen energy: it powers the Sun for billions of years, and opened the nuclear age.
给「活力之争」收场：运动的能量与力做的功从此可以互相换算。: Settled the vis viva debate: the energy of motion and the work of forces became interconvertible.
流得快的地方压强低：喷雾器、机翼和球赛里的弧线球都记在这本账上。: Faster flow, lower pressure: sprayers, wings, and curve balls all live here.
把三条气体实验定律并成一条，压强、体积、温度互相换算，热机有了设计图。: Three gas laws merged into one — heat engines got a blueprint.
把「混乱」变成可数的量：熵就是微观状态数的对数。这条公式刻在他的墓碑上。: Made “disorder” countable — carved on Boltzmann’s tombstone.
孤立系统的熵只增不减——物理学里第一支指明时间方向的箭头。: Entropy never decreases in an isolated system — physics’ first arrow of time.
摆的周期只由摆长和重力决定，摆钟因此可以校准，时间第一次被测准。: Period depends only on length and gravity — pendulum clocks made time measurable.
弹簧伸长与拉力成正比。弹簧秤、避震器和整门弹性力学从这里开始。: Extension is proportional to tension. Spring scales, dampers, and elasticity theory start here.
约翰内斯·开普勒（牛顿补上质量项）: Johannes Kepler (Newton added the mass term)
行星周期的平方正比于轨道半长轴的立方：太阳系的天平，用周期称出行星轨道。: Period squared ∝ orbit cubed: the solar system’s balance scale.
光进新介质拐多少度可以预先算出，望远镜、显微镜和眼镜片都靠它设计。: It predicts how much light bends entering a medium — telescopes and lenses use it.
电荷是电场的源头：数清包住的电荷，就知道穿出多少电场线。: Charge is the source of electric fields: enclosed charge sets the flux.
磁场没有源头：磁感线永远闭合，磁单极子至今没人找到。: Magnetic fields have no sources: field lines always close, and no monopole has ever been found.
变化的磁场会生出电场。发电机、变压器和电磁炉全都靠这条公式吃饭。: A changing magnetic field makes an electric one — generators and transformers live on it.
电流能造磁，变化的电场也能。补上这一项后，电磁波在纸上被预言出来。: Currents make magnetism — so do changing fields. Waves were predicted on paper.
从两个电学常数算出电磁波速，正好等于光速——光因此被认出是电磁波。: Two constants gave the speed of electromagnetic waves — light speed. Light was unmasked.
电磁场推电荷的完整规则：电动机、显像管和粒子加速器都按它运行。: The full rule for fields pushing charges: motors, tubes, accelerators.
电压、电流、电阻三者的换算表，整个电路工程的字母表。: The conversion between voltage, current, and resistance — the alphabet of circuit engineering.
电流发多少热可以预先算清：保险丝、电暖器和输电损耗都按它设计。: Resistive heating made computable: fuses, heaters, and transmission losses are designed with it.
线圈绕多密、电流多大，磁场就多强：电磁铁第一次可以按图纸制造。: Turn density times current sets the field: electromagnets could finally be built to a drawing.
电感电容回路的固有节拍：收音机和无线电的调谐原理。: The natural beat of an LC loop: the tuning principle of radio.
电容能存多少能量有了定量答案，相机闪光灯与电源滤波都靠它估算。: How much energy a capacitor stores, quantified — camera flashes and power filters are sized with it.
频率乘波长等于波速：从琴弦到 Wi-Fi，所有波的通用换算。: Frequency times wavelength equals wave speed: the universal conversion for strings to Wi-Fi.
量子世界的运动方程：波函数如何随时间演化，原子和化学键都由它算。: The quantum equation of motion: how wave functions evolve — atoms and bonds are computed with it.
为什么原子只有特定的能量：允许的能量是算符的本征值，像琴弦只有特定音高。: Why atoms have only certain energies: eigenvalues, like a string has only certain notes.
位置与动量不能同时测准——不是仪器不行，是自然本身不设这个状态。: Position and momentum cannot both be sharp — not an instrument limit, nature has no such state.
能量只能一份一份地交换。为黑体辐射解围的权宜之计，意外打开了量子时代。: Energy trades only in packets. A patch for black-body radiation that opened the quantum age.
粒子也是波：电子因此能衍射，电子显微镜的放大本领由此而来。: Particles are waves too: electrons can diffract — the resolving power of electron microscopes.
光电子的能量只随频率涨、不随亮度涨：光由一颗颗光子组成的判决证据。: Photoelectron energy grows with frequency, not brightness — proof of photons.
波函数不告诉你粒子在哪，只告诉你概率：量子世界的第一条统计规则。: The wave function gives probabilities, not positions — the quantum world’s first rule.
先测位置再测动量，换个顺序结果就不同：矩阵力学的心跳。: Measure position then momentum, or reversed — the order matters. The heartbeat of matrix mechanics.
电子只能站在固定的台阶上：氢光谱一条条谱线的位置第一次被算对。: Electrons stand only on fixed steps: the hydrogen spectrum was computed for the first time.
不被束缚的粒子是一列行波：量子教科书的第一个波函数。: An unbound particle is a travelling wave: the first wave function in every quantum textbook.
把量子力学和相对论缝进同一条方程，顺手预言了正电子——四年后被找到。: Sewed quantum mechanics and relativity into one equation, predicting the positron.
寿命越短的态，能量越说不准：谱线的天然宽度由此而来。: Shorter-lived states have less certain energy — the natural width of spectral lines.
五个最要紧的常数——0、1、e、π、i——被同一个等号串在一起。: The five most important constants — 0, 1, e, π, i — tied by one equals sign.
直角三角形三边的永恒关系：量地、盖房、导航都从这里出发。: The eternal relation of a right triangle’s sides: surveying, building, and navigation start here.
不管怎么捏凸多面体，点减棱加面恒等于 2：拓扑学的第一颗种子。: However you reshape a convex polyhedron, V − E + F stays 2: the first seed of topology.
微分和积分互为逆运算：算面积不必再穷竭分割，找原函数就行。: Differentiation and integration are inverses: no more exhausting slices — find an antiderivative.
指数函数可以写成无穷多项式：计算机和计算器算 eˣ 就靠这类展开。: The exponential as an infinite polynomial: computers evaluate eˣ with expansions like this.
由勾股定理直接推出: Follows directly from the Pythagorean theorem
同一个角正弦与余弦的平方和恒为 1：所有三角换算的总闸门。: For any angle, sin² plus cos² is one: the master switch of trigonometry.
欧拉引入 / 黎曼深挖: Introduced by Euler / deepened by Riemann
素数分布的密码本。它的零点在哪里，是悬赏一百万美元的千禧年难题。: The codebook of primes. Where its zeros lie is a million-dollar Millennium Problem.
整体与部分的特殊比例：连分数全为 1 的极限，斐波那契数列相邻项之比。: The special ratio of whole to part: the all-ones continued fraction, limit of Fibonacci neighbors.
钟形曲线下的总面积恰好是 √π：正态分布的归一化常数由此而来。: The area under the bell curve is exactly √π: the normal distribution’s normalization constant.
任何信号都能拆成一堆纯频率：MP3、JPEG、Wi-Fi 全都长在它上面。: Any signal splits into pure frequencies: MP3, JPEG, and Wi-Fi all grow out of this.
任何二次方程都能机械求解。代数学（algebra）的名字就来自他的著作。: Any quadratic solves mechanically. Algebra itself is named after al-Khwarizmi’s book.
新证据如何更新旧判断：从垃圾邮件过滤到现代机器学习都靠它迭代。: How new evidence should update old beliefs: spam filters and machine learning both iterate on it.
阶乘涨得有多快的渐近答案：统计物理和组合计数的常用扳手。: How fast factorials grow, asymptotically: a trusty wrench of statistical physics and counting.
无源之处的平衡方程：引力势、电势、稳态温度分布都服从它。: The source-free equilibrium equation: gravity, electric, and steady-temperature potentials obey it.
用切线快速逼近方程的根：每迭代一次精度大约翻一倍，至今是数值计算的标配。: Approximates roots with tangents, doubling precision each step — a numerical standard.
任意次幂都能展开成级数：牛顿靠它打开了无穷级数与微积分的大门。: Any power expands into a series — Newton used it to open infinite series and calculus.
时空告诉物质怎么动，物质告诉时空怎么弯：广义相对论的核心方程。: Spacetime tells matter how to move; matter tells it how to curve — relativity.
动得越快的钟走得越慢。不是理论游戏：GPS 卫星每天都得拿它校准。: Faster clocks run slower. Not just theory: GPS satellites correct for it daily.
再怎么叠加也超不过光速：牛顿时代「速度直接相加」到此为止。: No combination of boosts ever exceeds light speed — the end of simply adding velocities.
花粉在水中乱走的平均距离可以算出来：第一次用实验测出原子的真实大小。: The mean wander of pollen became computable — the first experimental measure of the size of atoms.
